title: RPC-style function proxy + idempotent retry guides for SDK function calling
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Problem: Current SDK helpers for function/tool calling surface schema validation and simple retries but leave a lot of heavy lifting to callers. We see recurring issues in production: duplicate side-effects from retries, hard-to-recover streaming sessions, and brittle schema errors across language SDKs. Goal: standardize an 'RPC-style invocation envelope' in SDKs (Python/TS/Go) that provides a stable client-side proxy for function calls with built-in idempotency, structured retry policies, streaming checkpointing, and lenient/strict validation modes. This ticket defines the design and produces example implementations and docs.
non_goals: Replace server-side contract enforcement (server must still validate),
proposed_design: Introduce InvocationOptions object (idempotency_key, retry_policy, validation_mode, streaming_checkpoint_handler)
Provide SDK-level proxy that wraps calls into an 'invoke envelope' containing invocation_id and idempotency_key
Expose three retry modes: none, idempotent-retry (safe by default), and at-most-once (best-effort using server acknowledgement)
Streaming: checkpoint/resume by sequence-token in envelope; SDK exposes a resume() helper that replays until checkpoint and continues streaming from server-provided resume token.
Schema validation: two runtime modes - 'strict' (error on mismatch) and 'compat' (coerce/ignore extra fields and attach warnings to telemetry). Provide a validation linter CLI for dev-time warnings.
Telemetry: emit invocation.lifecycle events (invocation.start, invocation.retry, invocation.fail, invocation.complete) and retry.reason tags (network, server-5xx, validation) for Console dashboards.
api_changes: Add new type InvocationOptions in all SDKs
Add invoke_with_options(...) wrapper for existing call helpers to keep backward compatibility
Streaming: add CheckpointToken type and ResumeHandle in SDKs
acceptance_criteria: Cross-language examples (Python, TypeScript, Go) demonstrating idempotent retry against a test harness
Unit tests for retry backoff jitter and idempotency envelope semantics
Integration test showing streaming resume from a checkpoint token
Documentation page describing validation_mode behavior and migration guidance
Telemetry events visible in Console (test dashboard showing invocation lifecycle)
implementation_notes: Step 1: define common JSON envelope schema and publish to SDK RFC doc (RFC-INV-2026)
Step 2: implement thin proxy in TS SDK first (fast iteration) and add example server harness in Go for integration tests
Step 3: port patterns to Python and Go SDKs, reusing common logic where possible (validation rules/routines)
Retry defaults: client default = idempotent-retry with exponential backoff (base=200ms, max=8s, max_attempts=3)
Telemetry notes: use existing SDK telemetry channel with new event names and include 'validation_mode' and 'idempotency_key' (hashed) in payload
